Default-layout compatibility fixtures

The table in libs/paths/src/layout_tests.rs applies main's 32650ae5:libs/config/src/dir.rs match arms by hand: a direct override wins, then the whole-tree root, then uid defaults; share ignores the whole-tree root. It does not compute expectations with a second resolver. The original ten dir.rs tests and all their assertions are retained in libs/paths/src/lib.rs.

Each fixture runs for both uid 0 and uid 1000, with executable inputs /opt/mixos/bin/x and /srv/moved tree/bin/x. That is twenty cases, asserting all six roots. In the table, P is /opt/mixos or /srv/moved tree; prefix is P in every case. Expected etc, var, run and share come from main; cache is additive, using the same uid/XDG rules.

Fixtureuidetcvarruncacheshare
desk-isolated0/var/lib/mixos/desk/etc/var/lib/mixos/desk/var/run/mixos/session/3/var/cache/mixos/opt/mixos/share
desk-isolated1000/var/lib/mixos/desk/etc/var/lib/mixos/desk/var/run/mixos/session/3/home/user/.cache/mixos/opt/mixos/share
desk-shared0/var/lib/mixos/vt/etc/var/lib/mixos/vt/var/run/mixos/session/4/var/cache/mixos/opt/mixos/share
desk-shared1000/var/lib/mixos/vt/etc/var/lib/mixos/vt/var/run/mixos/session/4/home/user/.cache/mixos/opt/mixos/share
system-unit0/etc/mixos/var/lib/mixos/run/mixos/var/cache/mixosP/share
system-unit1000/root/.config/mixos/var/lib/mixos/tmp/mixos-run/root/.cache/mixosP/share
bare-login0/etc/mixos/var/lib/mixos/run/mixos/var/cache/mixosP/share
bare-login1000/home/user/.config/mixos/home/user/.local/share/mixos/run/user/1000/mixos/home/user/.cache/mixosP/share
bare-root0/etc/mixos/var/lib/mixos/run/mixos/var/cache/mixosP/share
bare-root1000/root/.config/mixos/root/.local/share/mixos/tmp/mixos-run/root/.cache/mixosP/share

Share follows the moved executable unless explicitly pinned by MIXOS_SHARE. Nothing else changes when P moves. The system-unit user case has no HOME, so main's /root home fallback applies. A user run root with no absolute XDG_RUNTIME_DIR retains main's /tmp/mixos-run fallback.

Inputs, with no additional variables injected:

desk-isolated:
  HOME=/home/user
  MIXOS_ETC=/var/lib/mixos/desk/etc
  MIXOS_VAR=/var/lib/mixos/desk/var
  MIXOS_RUN=/run/mixos/session/3
  MIXOS_SHARE=/opt/mixos/share
  XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/mixos/session/3/desktop

desk-shared:
  HOME=/home/user
  MIXOS_ETC=/var/lib/mixos/vt/etc
  MIXOS_VAR=/var/lib/mixos/vt/var
  MIXOS_RUN=/run/mixos/session/4
  MIXOS_SHARE=/opt/mixos/share
  XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/mixos/session/4/desktop
  XDG_CONFIG_HOME=/var/lib/mixos/vt/home/config
  XDG_DATA_HOME=/var/lib/mixos/vt/home/data

system-unit:
  MIXOS_VAR=/var/lib/mixos

bare-login:
  HOME=/home/user
  XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/1000

bare-root:
  HOME=/root

Other tests cover all original assertions, explicit tiers, empty and relative inputs, non-UTF-8 HOME, whole-tree precedence, strict layout keys and bounds, logical-path escapes and a real prefix/symlink move. Parser fixtures under libs/paths/tests/layout/ also pass through the real Mix load_data builtin in libs/mix/tests/layout_data.rs, comparing grammar acceptance and decoded path bytes. These Rust checks run on CBC, not on developer desktops.
